antecedent.v19_sparse: On the 387-row V17 exploratory validation, the full-session sparse checkpoint improved paired median position by 24.8% but regressed paired P95 position by 149.9%; an observable reprojection-residual gate recovered only about 16% aggregate P95 position improvement.
antecedent.v19_dense: The homography-plus-free-local-UV dense checkpoint had only 30.8% candidate validity and multi-metre P95 error. Zeroing the local UV residual did not rescue the learned global-corner head because its global-average pooling discarded spatial location.
antecedent.solver: A raw-corner homography sampled densely can occasionally jump to a different planar basin in the independent dense DLT route; observable raw-PnP modes may therefore seed dense refinement, but labels may not.

online_contract.fallback: unchanged raw YOLO PnP when the candidate is invalid, geometrically degenerate, or rejected by the observable risk gate

development_data.formal_validation: collect a future untouched full-session pack after all V20 weights, gates, and thresholds are frozen
development_data.formal_test: collect or authorize a later sealed full-session pack only after formal validation passes

compute.production_parity_audit: CPU OpenCV IPPE is permitted only after a candidate is frozen, never for training or exploratory selection

sparse.distribution: calibrated in-ROI four-heatmap distribution plus continuous Gaussian tail
sparse.risk_gate: offline utility labels; online observable diagnostics only

dense.global_geometry: calibrated spatial four-corner distribution followed by one projective homography

offline_truth_usage.inference: all label/reference dictionaries can be deleted before forward and pose solve

deletable: explicit current-task reproducible caches after decisive manifests and reproduction commands are retained
